description: Highest-priority rule — fires when mate_threat_evidence is present (engine sees mate via PV-suffix '#' OR eval-sentinel |eval|>=9000 OR board.is_checkmate after the played move). Variants branch by who delivers, from whose POV, ply count, and whether mate was already forced before this move. IMPORTANT: the *_pawns variants fire when ply_to_mate is None — i.e. engine eval indicates mate (eval-sentinel) but PV didn't reveal the exact sequence. Don't say 'mate is on the board' in those variants (Mohit 2026-05-23: that overclaims since we can't show the line) — say 'engine sees a winning continuation' instead, which is honest about the eval signal without claiming an identifiable mate.

fact_glossary.ply: Number of plies to mate (1, 2, 3, ...) or null when engine has no clean ply count
fact_glossary.pawn_swing: Eval swing rounded to pawns (1-9) — used by the *_pawns variants to gate on a non-zero swing. NOTE: do NOT render this as 'N pawns of advantage' (memory rule: cp_loss-is-not-material). It's a present/absent gate, not a quantity to display.
fact_glossary.delivered_on_this_move: true when this move IS the checkmate move
fact_glossary.mover_delivers: true when the side that just moved is the side delivering the future mate
fact_glossary.mover_is_user: true if the user just moved
fact_glossary.mate_already_on_board: true when mate was already forced before this move (player failed to defend, not caused the mate)

variants.mate_on_for_user_p1: {played_san}. Mate is on for you next move.
variants.mate_on_for_user_pN: {played_san}. Mate is on for you in {ply}.
variants.mate_on_for_user_pawns: {played_san}. Opponent's position collapses — the engine sees a winning continuation for you.
variants.mate_on_for_user_bare: {played_san}. Opponent's position swings decisively against them.
variants.user_misses_defense_p1: {played_san} misses the defense against mate next move.
variants.user_misses_defense_pN: {played_san} misses the defense against mate in {ply}.
variants.user_already_lost: {played_san} — the position was already lost before this move.
variants.user_allows_pawns: {played_san} — the position now collapses. Engine sees a winning continuation for opponent.
variants.user_allows_bare: {played_san} — engine sees the position turning against you.
